name: TTEOP (Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol)
description: TTEOP (Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol) is an open, vendor-neutral interoperability standard for measuring AI-operator token efficiency. This deposit contains the complete v0.1.3-draft release archive, including: SPEC.md — the protocol specification JSON schemas for telemetry envelopes Five derived metric definitions (Yield, Leverage, Velocity, output_fraction, log_leverage) with banker's rounding Four telemetry primitives (input, output, cache_write, cache_read) Three privacy modes (public-pseudonymous, private-managed-cohort, enterprise-isolated) Four provenance levels (self-reported, collector-attested, platform-verified, signed) Conformance suite with frozen test vectors (154 JS assertions, 25 Python tests) Governance documents and TEP process Reference implementation (JavaScript, Node.js >= 18) npm package: tteop-spec@0.1.3-draft The canonical MOSES seed vector produces: Yield=18436.98, Leverage=2042.2, Velocity=9.028, output_fraction=0.9003, log_leverage=3.31.
